Research & experience

Vanderbilt University Medical Center

Research intern · March 2025 – present
Department of Radiology

  • Conducted a retrospective analysis of emergency department head CT imaging from 2018–2023 to evaluate adherence to ACR Appropriateness Criteria for headache presentations.
  • Assessed provider decision-making patterns and their association with guideline compliance and emergency department length of stay.
  • Collaborated with attending radiologists on study design, reviewed the imaging-utilization literature, and drafted a research manuscript.

Scholarly work

Presented. Two posters at the American Headache Society 68th Annual Scientific Meeting.

Accepted. First-author poster for the RSNA 2026 Annual Meeting on ACR Appropriateness Criteria adherence and emergency department length of stay.

Submitted. Manuscript submitted to the Journal of the American Society of Emergency Radiology.

Stanford School of Medicine

Research intern · June – July 2024
Department of Radiology

  • Co-authored a neonatal brain MRI study comparing variable denoising levels at 3T. The work was presented at the Meharry Research Day Symposium and published in the Journal of Clinical Imaging Science.
  • Co-authored a case report on neonatal hypoglycemia, its injury extent, and potential causes identified on brain MRI, published in Neuropediatrics.
  • Observed pediatric neuroradiologists interpreting scans and attended conferences discussing clinically relevant findings.

Clinical Cardiovascular Research Institute
